what_it_is.prose: Asteria Aerospace is a Bengaluru-based full-stack drone OEM founded in 2011 by Neel Mehta and Nihar Vartak, offering surveillance/mapping VTOL platforms (A200-XT, AT-15) alongside the SkyDeck SaaS drone-operations platform. Its AT-15 VTOL UAV achieved Asteria's largest-ever Indian Army contract delivery in December 2024, and its A200-XT rotorcraft is listed on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM). The company is one of the few Indian OEMs to combine proprietary hardware with an in-house analytics stack, with revenue reportedly growing ~90% in FY25.

faq.question: When was Asteria Aerospace founded and who are its founders?
faq.answer: Asteria Aerospace was founded in 2011 in Bengaluru by Neel Mehta and Nihar Vartak.

faq.question: Which Asteria Aerospace drone was supplied to the Indian Army under its largest-ever contract?
faq.answer: The AT-15 VTOL UAV. Asteria Aerospace announced successful delivery of its largest-ever AT-15 contract to the Indian Army in December 2024.
